**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Open 2.5 ton - 5 ton Trucks (hi) and compare live SEO headings with the snapshot. Allure and artifacts/seo-structure-report.xlsx show expected vs actual so a changed heading can be copied into test data after it is confirmed.

**Expected Result:**
Every stored heading on 2.5 ton - 5 ton Trucks (hi) is still present with the same tag. Extra or missing headings fail the check; order on the page may differ.

1. Open 2.5 ton - 5 ton Trucks (hi)

3. Compare live headings with the stored snapshot
